text: Four-person pod at Oliver's, Tuesday October 20th, 2026: me, Oliver, Tom, and Ryan. Two games, started off with our pre-cons. I played my Sai, Master Thopterist, mono blue from the Foundations collection, and it's good. Pre-cons always take a long time. There's nothing in terms of feedback around the cards, the distribution, the draw, or anything like that because it's a pre-con, and I'm just going to play it as a pre-con, not going to modify it. So these are just pilot's notes. Sai is pretty cheap, CMC comes out for three. Every artifact, which is basically all of the cards, mints you a Thopter. I had some nice large things out there that were buffed by the number of artifacts I control. I didn't draw into any artifact discount cards. I had a couple of things that felt win-condition-y, but I didn't know how I was going to get around some of the wider board states people had, because there's no trample. There is a lot of flying though. I didn't get to play Steel Kite Dragon, which is a cool card, I wanted to. I definitely felt like I was a threat and holding my own throughout most of the game. I didn't win. Who won the pre-con game, Tom or Ryan? I can't even remember. That pre-con game was so boring; they take a couple hours.
